goal: Turn completed Harness task outcomes into durable, deduplicated, human-reviewable governed-memory candidates immediately, while keeping Obsidian as the approval adapter and periodic jobs as reconciliation only.

acceptance_criteria.description: A completed Harness task with a promoted task_outcome memory immediately creates one need_review governed-memory candidate and one Obsidian Inbox note without waiting for cron.
Replaying the same task outcome is idempotent: the stable candidate, note, and state-changing audit are not duplicated.
A reviewed candidate is never overwritten by event replay or reconciliation, and an unchanged reconciliation writes no audit event.
If immediate distillation fails, the completed task remains completed and records a distillation failure event so periodic reconciliation can repair the missing candidate.
The periodic task-outcome exporter uses the same candidate adapter and becomes a no-op after event-driven publication.
Only the bounded task summary and provenance are distilled; complete prompts, complete executor answers, and raw chat archives are not persisted into the candidate audit payload.

non_goals: Do not auto-approve task outcome candidates.
Do not make Obsidian the runtime fact database.
Do not persist complete prompts, complete task results, or full chat archives into governed memory.
Do not let distillation failure roll back completed business work.
